looks.explanation: I’d start with your white graphic tee, but it’s casual, so it isn’t a formal wedding outfit on its own. To dress it up, you’d need to borrow or rent tailored trousers or a dressy skirt and dress shoes; a dress shirt or dressy blouse would be a more formal alternative top. Check the invitation’s dress code before deciding whether the tee is appropriate.
